summary: The change does what was asked, and I found no blocker or major problems, so the verdict is pass. It adds the full id f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, with a comment giving the reason, following the ee4b0dd precedent. It also adds decision D70 (with decision, alternatives, tradeoff, reversal and provenance, citing D60, D67, D68 and D69) and a CHANGELOG line. All three give the same reason: most of PR #9's jobs predate athena.candidate/2, so D69's chain rule cannot link them. OP-11 appears nowhere in the repository. Only the three expected files changed. `cargo test` passes, including the config tests that parse athena.toml and validate the exempt list. There is one nit: D70 admits that the id was not checked against history, which matches the reading's assumption.
